records.claimDecision: Direct Internet Method is a standalone product for Windows and Linux; FreeNetHub integration is downstream and not required for normal use.
Both platform UIs use a dedicated free-dove icon and display the user-specified slogan; Linux includes explicit Minimize, Maximize/Restore and Close controls plus a draggable standard header.
Use a temporary dedicated DNS link and resolve1 D-Bus routing; stage nfqws hostlist in /run; enable ctrld WAN clients only on the product-owned listener.
Only hash-pinned Windows and Linux final artifacts are eligible for GitHub v1.0.0 release.
